title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
author: Agatha Christie
summary: A wealthy man is found stabbed in his study in a quiet English village, and Poirot, newly retired next door, is persuaded to investigate. The local doctor narrates the case.
readIf: you want one of the most famous and talked-about puzzles in classic crime fiction.
skipIf: you have already been told the twist, as the whole book is built around it.

pairings.reason: A modern, warmer English-village mystery that likes to play with the same kind of clever misdirection.
Another classic detective story with a strong sense of English place, but moodier and more gothic.
